result.summary: A residential street environment with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant cracking and patching, and parked vehicles near the intersection area create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the roadway without designated markings or right-of-way protection.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway and sidewalk transition areas are heavily cracked and uneven, creating trip hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement to provide a smooth and safe walking and driving surface.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic calming measures. The presence of parked cars on both sides creates significant sightline obstructions at potential crossing points, while the wide, unmarked one-way roadway may facilitate higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: No painted markings to designate pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracks, patches, and debris in the roadway and gutter area could pose tripping hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install physical vertical deflections to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street lined with brick row houses and a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk. The environment lacks visible traffic control devices, lane markings, or pedestrian crossing infrastructure in this mid-block perspective.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing area is visible, which may encourage unsafe mid-block crossings in a residential zone.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective width for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk in front of the residential buildings

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide shade and act as a natural traffic calming measure to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding street lights would improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, unmarked residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The absence of lane markings and crosswalks, combined with the street's width, creates an environment where vehicle speeds may be high and pedestrian visibility is limited by parked cars.
